stem: Bilal is still growing and also trains for school races. His coach says paneer and moong dal supply proteins that help build muscle and support proper growth and development.

parts.text: How should he classify proteins as food components?

options.text: Components needed for muscle building, proper growth, and development.
Components needed only after growth has already finished.
Components a growing child needs in any tiny amount.
Components that cannot come from paneer or moong dal.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Proteins help build muscle and support proper growth, so growing children and sportspersons need enough of them; paneer and moong dal are sources.

teacher.key_rationale: Proteins are food components for muscle building and proper growth. They are needed during growth, not only after it; any tiny amount is not enough; paneer and moong dal are protein sources.
